title: Presumed Innocent
author: Scott Turow
summary: A veteran prosecutor is asked to investigate the murder of a colleague with whom he once had an affair. As evidence mounts, he finds himself the accused in his own courtroom.
readIf: you like legal thrillers with a deep look at ambition, marriage and how the courts really work.
skipIf: you want fast action; it is a measured, procedural book with a lot of talk.

pairings.reason: Another courtroom drama, but with a clearer moral spine and a more emotional centre.
A faster, lighter legal thriller with a young lawyer who finds out his job is dangerous.
Another study of a cool, plausible man dealing with a crime that threatens to expose him.
